Experimental_Design.Conditions: Implicit self-binding: learned shape<->self/other labels (2 shapes), moral-character words presented INSIDE the shapes (to be ignored); 2 (matching) x 2 (self/other) x 3 (moral word), within-subject

exp4a_1.detail: Implicit self-binding (self x good character). Matching = shape<->self/other label (YesNoResp). Shape = geometry file (SqrG.bmp etc. = square/circle with moral word rendered inside); extraIV1 = the moral word inside the shape (Good/Normal/Bad, Normal=Neutral). Shape identity = learned association (raw Shape column Self/Other); Label = 自己/他人. Subject re-coded +4100 per author (raw 1-32). Table 1 N=32 (29): 3 low-accuracy excluded.
